name: 3D Avatar Maker
description: Build a 3D avatar for a character or persona on its own Home tab: choose a body, shape it, pick skin, eyes, hair and clothes, then save it as a VRM or GLB file and import it under the 3D Avatars agent. No other software is needed. Alpha: the avatar blinks, talks, shows feelings and swings its hair; more is coming. Install it, then open Home → 3D Avatar Maker.
author: ThatOneCan
